answer_1.quote: In this paper, we conduct a detailed analysis of error types of P-CoT and N-CoT paradigms and seek to merge the benefits of these two paradigms for mutual promotion, based on which we propose Parrot, a novel training pipeline that integrates three target-designed subtasks for the sequential P-CoT and N-CoT generations.
answer_1.outputs: natural language chain-of-thought (N-CoT) rationales and program chain-of-thought (P-CoT) solutions
